records.title: Создание губернии Северная Карелия
records.historical_summary: В 1960 г. восточная часть губернии Куопио была выделена в губернию Северная Карелия, куда вошёл и Иломантси. 1 сентября 1997 г. губерния вошла в состав Восточной Финляндии.
records.historical_summary_en: In 1960 the eastern part of Kuopio Province was separated as North Karelia Province, which included Ilomantsi. On 1 September 1997 it became part of Eastern Finland Province.

evidence.supports: 1960 established from Kuopio län; Ilomants listed; abolished 1.9.1997
eastern part separated 1960 as Northern Karelia
Decree 26/1960 establishing posts in the new provincial governments of North Karelia and Central Finland and abolishing posts in the Kuopio and Vaasa provincial governments
